findings.title: No block consumes calibration's ZQCS request — periodic ZQ calibration can never be granted
findings.detail: calibration raises zqcs_req for periodic ZQ calibration (spec: calibration.periodic_recalibration_enable, interval 640us), and expects zqcs_ack. No other block in the drop has a matching port: the scheduler and cmd_gen accept no ZQCS request, and no arbiter exists to issue a ZQCS command on the DDR bus. The request can never be acknowledged by the design, so periodic recalibration is unreachable. The integration harness acks it with testbench glue (integration_map.json expr_glue) so the calibration FSM does not wedge; the design needs a scheduler-side zqcs_req/zqcs_ack pair (like refresh's ref_required/ref_ack) and a ZQCS entry in the command generator. Related: init_fsm's init_cmd_* outputs also reach no DDR-bus arbiter — cmd_gen drives the DDR pins directly, so init commands never appear on the bus either; the two gaps share a root cause (no command-bus mux/arbiter block).
